<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)>But to think a building as big as that could fly up that high

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Graças a ti, nós Pokémon <$voicel(1,8)>ficaram bastante habilidosos em
Agindo mais como humanos.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)>Mas pensar que um edifício tão grande como aquele poderia voar para cima daquele alto
para o céu...<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)>Os humanos podem fazer coisas incríveis.

... ... ...
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)>Do you suppose there’s any chance that...humans are

dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>... ... ...
... ... ...

dialogues.en: You picked up a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1743)></color>.
dialogues.pt_br: Apanhaste um... <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1743)></color>.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Astonishing... Humans really could do the most incredible
things.
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,666)>They didn’t just BUILD a big building like that...
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>They even made it fly up into the sky!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Espantosos... os humanos podiam fazer o mais incrível
Coisas.
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,666)>Eles não construíram apenas um edifício grande como aquele...
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>Até o fizeram voar para o céu!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>Our biggest hint may have blasted off and flown away, but
as I watched it go, I couldn’t help but think...
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)>Somewhere, somehow, humans will see that building. I’m
sure of it. <$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>And then they’ll come back here!
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,9)>I truly believe that!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>A nossa maior pista pode ter disparado e voado, mas...
enquanto eu assistia, não pude deixar de pensar...
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)>Em algum lugar, de alguma forma, os seres humanos vão ver aquele edifício.
Claro que sim. <$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>E então eles vão voltar aqui!
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,9)>Acredito mesmo nisso!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>So until that day arrives, let’s work together with the other
Pokémon here <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)>to make even nicer places to live.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>So those humans’ll be gobsmacked to see what they’re
coming home to!
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,39)>Let’s keep it up, <$cdef(27)>!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Então, até que esse dia chegue, vamos trabalhar juntos com o outro
Pokémon aqui. <$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)>para fazer lugares ainda mais agradáveis para viver.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Assim, esses humanos serão devastados para ver o que eles são
A voltar para casa!
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,39)>Vamos mantê-lo, <$cdef(27)>!
